title: Mining Unity VR Repositories for Refactoring Patterns and Technical Debt
abstract: arXiv:2611.18948v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Maintaining virtual reality (VR) applications poses challenges tied to real-time performance, hardware dependencies, and complex interactions. Yet little is known about how developers refactor these applications, which kinds of technical debt they address, or how well automated tools capture VR-specific changes. We mined 1,755 candidate refactoring commits from 176 open-source Unity VR repositories and manually examined a sample of 303 commits, of which 270 contained at least one refactoring. We also extended RefactoringMiner to create VRRefMiner, a tool that detects conventional refactorings in C# scripts used by Unity applications.   Our analysis found both conventional and VR-specific refactorings. VR-specific changes addressed concerns such as interaction logic, performance, and Unity-specific artifacts. Code debt was the most prevalent category overall, while interaction debt and UI/UX debt were the main categories addressed by VR-s

translated_title: 挖掘Unity VR仓库中的重构模式与技术债务
translated_abstract: 维护虚拟现实（VR）应用面临着与实时性能、硬件依赖和复杂交互相关的挑战。然而，人们对开发人员如何重构这些应用、他们解决哪些类型的技术债务，以及自动化工具能否很好地捕捉VR特定的变更知之甚少。我们从176个开源Unity VR仓库中挖掘了1,755个候选重构提交，并手动检查了其中303个提交的样本，其中270个包含至少一次重构。我们还扩展了RefactoringMiner，创建了VRRefMiner，这是一个用于检测Unity应用所使用的C#脚本中常规重构的工具。我们的分析同时发现了常规重构和VR特定的重构。VR特定的变更主要解决了交互逻辑、性能以及Unity特有产物等方面的问题。代码债务是总体上最普遍的技术债务类别，而交互债务和UI/UX债务则是VR应用中主要被处理的技术债务类别。
tldr: 该研究从176个开源Unity VR仓库中挖掘重构模式与技术债务，发现代码债务最为普遍，交互债务和UI/UX债务是VR应用的主要债务类别，并开发了VRRefMiner工具来检测Unity应用中的重构。
en_tdlr: This study mined refactoring patterns and technical debt from 176 open-source Unity VR repositories, finding code debt most prevalent and interaction/UI-UX debt as main VR-specific categories, and developed VRRefMiner to detect refactorings in Unity applications.
